status: Prescribed q=4 and q=5 leading-prefix recoveries and fixed six-row diagnostics.
scope: At each completed fixture, unisolvent-grid clearing proves the preimage identities over F_p(X0,X1,X2). The defect rank and fixed-row pattern are finite parameter witnesses, not all-q claims.
resource_measurement_scope: Calculation before JSON serialization; external time records complete-process use.

cases.indexing: All times, states, matrix row indices and source labels are zero based.
cases.fit_row_order: For each fit point, component 0 then component 1.

nonzero_minor.order: Rows and columns in listed order.
Rows and columns in listed order.
Rows and columns in listed order.

arbitrary_X_identity_control.newton_basis: prod_(r<i)(x-c-r) prod_(s<j)(y-e-s), ordered by i+j then i.
arbitrary_X_identity_control.unisolvence_argument: The Newton polynomials have distinct leading monomials x^i*y^j and form a basis for total degree <=d. At a node of smaller total degree at least one falling-factorial factor vanishes; distinct nodes of equal degree also give zero. Diagonal entries are i!j!, nonzero because p>d.
arbitrary_X_identity_control.denominator: D_old*Delta_last, where Delta_t=prod_a L_ta and D_old is the product over all q old times. Delta_last is Delta_(q-1) in the stored zero-based labels, and Delta_q in the paper.
arbitrary_X_identity_control.degree_argument: Every old E/F term uses each old block at most once. Appending K_q uses block q at most twice. The h*v_i*(I-K_q) and commutator terms have the same bounds. D_old*Delta_q of degree 3q+3 clears them; each row is homogeneous of degree 1, giving degree 3q+4. Setting X0=1 gives total degree at most d in X1,X2.
arbitrary_X_identity_control.arbitrary_X_conclusion: Zero evaluations on this unisolvent grid force each cleared affine polynomial to be zero. Homogeneity then forces the homogeneous cleared polynomial to be zero, including on X0=0. The identities hold over F_p(X0,X1,X2), and at every point where the common denominator is nonzero.

prefix_defect.row_basis: At row (t,a,b), the vector is X_a X_b/L_ta times e_b.

nonzero_minor.order: Rows and columns in listed order.

prefix_defect.constant_basis: X_b e_b, b=0,1,2; excluded from the pole rank.
